title: Perturbative Coulomb branches on $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$: the global D-term potential
summary: We find the perturbative potential on the 3d $\mathcal{N}\!=\!2$ Coulomb branch arising from a chiral 4d $\mathcal{N}\!=\!1$ gauge theory on $\mathbb{R}^3 \times S^1$, zeta-regularizing the D-term couplings generated by the Kaluza-Klein modes. This fills a significant gap in the literature on circle-compactified SUSY gauge theories. Unlike earlier indirect approaches to the circle reduction of chiral theories, our formula provides a global view of the Coulomb branch, necessary for capturing holonomy saddles and for systematic implementation.
